# Code of conduct

This code of conduct applies to every repository of the [SPAR Ontologies GitHub organisation](https://github.com/sparontologies), and to issues, pull requests and any other discussion related to the SPAR Ontologies.

## Expected behaviour

All contributors are expected to be respectful and constructive. In particular:

* discuss ideas, not people, and accept that a proposal may need a few iterations before being accepted;
* give and receive feedback in a constructive way;
* stay on topic, and keep each issue focused on one problem or proposal.

## Unacceptable behaviour

Harassment, personal attacks and discriminatory language are not tolerated, in any form.

## Enforcement

The [owners](https://github.com/orgs/SPAROntologies/people?utf8=%E2%9C%93&query=+role%3Aowner) of the SPAR Ontologies GitHub organisation may remove comments, close issues or pull requests, and block contributors that do not respect these rules.

To report a behaviour that violates this code of conduct, contact one of the owners of the organisation. Reports are handled confidentially.
